summary: The note describes Dornbusch, a region of low rolling hills in the northern part of the German Baltic Sea island of Hiddensee. The hills consist mainly of ice age deposits left behind after the glacier thawed. Dornbusch is one of three island cores of Hiddensee that gave rise to the lowland.
one_line: Dornbusch is a region of low hills in northern Hiddensee, a German Baltic Sea island, formed from ice age deposits.
key_facts: Dornbusch is a region of low rolling hills in the northern part of the German Baltic Sea island of Hiddensee.
The Dornbusch consists mainly of ice age depositions.
The ice age depositions were left behind after the glacier thawed.
Dornbusch is one of three island cores of Hiddensee.
The three island cores of Hiddensee are responsible for the emergence of the lowland.
Hiddensee is an island in the German Baltic Sea.
